## Projects

- [SIEM AI Analysis Server · Automated Incident Analysis](https://mmyonaa.github.io/#/project/siem-ai) — 2025.09 –. A Fastify AI server for SIEM security incident analysis. I built the analysis pipeline on data from a separately developed ingestion and normalization layer, independently developing the orchestrator, LiteLLM gateway, and tenant model management.
- [SIEM Operations Web Platform · Security Event Monitoring](https://mmyonaa.github.io/#/project/siem-web) — 2025.09 –. A Next.js 15 full-stack web application for a multi-tenant SIEM security platform. I co-developed the SIEM dashboard and incident management with the team, and independently developed the AI report editor.
